Theorem
[Uniqueness for Cauchy problem, small-time case]

↗ thm:maximum-principle-heat-cauchy-problem-smalltime \group Maximum Principles

Let $u,v\in C(\R ^n\times [0,T])$ be $C^2$ on $\R ^n\times (0,T)$, agree at $t=0$, and suppose $u-v$ solves the homogeneous heat equation. If $|u|,|v|\le Ae^{a|x|^2}$ and $4aT<1$, then $u=v$.
Proof

\sketch Apply the small-time maximum principle to $\pm (u-v)$ with growth constant $2A$ and initial bound $0$.

□
